SELECT o.id AS option_id, o.option_code, o.name AS option_name, o.selection_type, o.is_required, o.min_select, o.max_select, o.sort AS option_sort, v.id AS value_id, v.value_code, v.name AS value_name, v.price_delta, v.sort AS value_sort FROM dc_product_option o LEFT JOIN dc_product_option_value v ON v.option_id = o.id AND v.status = 'ACTIVE' AND v.deleted = 0 WHERE o.product_id = #{productId} AND o.status = 'ACTIVE' AND o.deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.sort, o.id, v.sort, v.id
SELECT id, extra_code, name, price, stock, sort FROM dc_product_extra WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort, id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dc_product (category_id, product_code, name, description, image_url, price, original_price, stock, is_recommended, is_new, status, sort) VALUES (#{product.categoryId}, #{product.productCode}, #{product.name}, #{product.description}, #{product.imageUrl}, #{product.price}, #{product.originalPrice}, #{product.stock}, #{product.recommended}, #{product.isNew}, 'DRAFT', #{product.sort})
mapper.update: UPDATE dc_product_option_value v JOIN dc_product_option o ON o.id = v.option_id SET v.deleted = 1, v.status = 'INACTIVE' WHERE o.product_id = #{productId}
UPDATE dc_product_option SET deleted = 1, status = 'INACTIVE' WHERE product_id = #{productId}
UPDATE dc_product_extra SET deleted = 1, status = 'INACTIVE' WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dc_product_option (product_id, option_code, name, selection_type, is_required, min_select, max_select, sort, status, deleted) VALUES (#{productId}, #{option.code}, #{option.name}, #{option.selectionType}, #{option.required}, #{option.minSelect}, #{option.maxSelect}, #{option.sort}, 'ACTIVE', 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), selection_type = VALUES(selection_type), is_required = VALUES(is_required), min_select = VALUES(min_select), max_select = VALUES(max_select), sort = VALUES(sort), status = 'ACTIVE', deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM dc_product_option WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND option_code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dc_product_option_value (option_id, value_code, name, price_delta, sort, status, deleted) VALUES (#{optionId}, #{value.code}, #{value.name}, #{value.priceDelta}, #{value.sort}, 'ACTIVE', 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), price_delta = VALUES(price_delta), sort = VALUES(sort), status = 'ACTIVE', deleted = 0

INSERT INTO dc_product_extra (product_id, extra_code, name, price, stock, sort, status, deleted) VALUES (#{productId}, #{extra.code}, #{extra.name}, #{extra.price}, #{extra.stock}, #{extra.sort}, 'ACTIVE', 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), price = VALUES(price), stock = VALUES(stock), sort = VALUES(sort), status = 'ACTIVE', deleted = 0

UPDATE dc_product SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

mapper.update: UPDATE dc_product SET stock = stock + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND stock + #{delta} >= 0
